assessments.rule: The case coordinator opens each move with photos of every room and the quoted price.
A final settling-in visit is due within ten days of the move.
The booking desk opens each party with a photo of the client's signed safety agreement and the quoted price per child.
Only the lead arborist can approve treating trees inside a wood quarantine zone, recording the forestry permit and the extra fee.
A candidate who fails may retest within 30 days at half price.
A move delayed by weather may be rescheduled within 60 days of its booked date.
The estimator opens each job with before photos of every chip and rust stain and the quoted price.
The design must be approved at least 60 days before the team's ring ceremony or the order is cancelled with the deposit kept.

method: Match actual calibrated field and operation, not unrelated witness presence. Unsupported upload/window/approval shapes do not count.
